cases.task: Choose the safe SSE rule when a resume cursor is greater than the durable event log high-water sequence.

required_facts.text: A resume cursor ahead of the durable tail can leave a healthy-looking stream blind to all later events below that cursor.
The server must not certify the ahead cursor with a ready frame or silently clamp it.
Return a versioned terminal cursor-ahead outcome with the exact requested and high-water decimal cursors, close reconnect, and require explicit operator reset.
